rubrics.justification: Generally identifies a blastocyst with large blastocoel and thinning zona, but overstates confidence in ICM/TE quality from this single image; the image appears somewhat collapsed/asymmetric and the exact AA features are not clearly visible.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, tubal factor, prior IVF history, endometrial thickness, sperm parameters, oocyte yield, smoking, and possible hydrosalpinx with embryo prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with a plausible probability range tied to embryo quality and patient factors; only minor overinterpretation of morphology limits a perfect score.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines, including SET for a good-quality Day 5 blastocyst and attention to hydrosalpinx, cavity assessment, luteal support, and smoking cessation; minor grading-stage ambiguity prevents a top score.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, hydrosalpinx exclusion, cavity evaluation, lifestyle changes, supplementation, and future-cycle review.
